outcome: firm, tender mass in the right iliac fossa
cohort: A 34-year-old woman with a history of two previous Cesarean sections presented with abdominal pain and vomiting.
finding: A gossypiboma, a retained surgical sponge, was found mimicking a peri-appendiceal abscess in a 34-year-old woman with a history of two prior Cesarean sections, highlighting a preventable "never event" in surgical practice.
mod_finding: The patient's gossypiboma was identified after she had undergone two prior Cesarean sections.
